parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Market-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104 | 2.86 | 2.86
2 | 186 | 2.38 | 5.24
3 | 266 | 24.7 | 29.9
4 | 327 | 24.6 | 54.6
5 | 219 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Market-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AAA-type
Aquifer depth: 29.9 – 54.6 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of approximately 60 m to fully penetrate the productive sand aquifer, and install well screens with appropriate gravel packing within the primary water-bearing horizon.
